primaryContext.candidateText: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

primaryContext.candidateText: He arose, and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, God’s Mountain.
